subject: Next steps: 60–90m technical workshop & calendar options
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Liu <devon.liu@edgepay.com>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya.r@edgepay.com>
Date: 2026-11-22 09:12 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + proposed 60–90m technical workshop windows

Hey Devon — thanks again for the productive discovery session this morning. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps to get your infra and ML teams aligned: 

Recap (from my notes)
- Primary goal: move from PoC to production with predictable latency and cost per transaction.
- Key constraints: PCI-scope data paths, VPC-only access for inference, and strict uptime SLA for peak periods.
- Priorities: 1) runtime performance and autoscaling behavior, 2) data controls and KMS integration, 3) quantization/accuracy trade-offs for our model mix.

Proposal: a 60–90 minute technical workshop with our ML/Infra engineers to walk through runtime architecture, deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and an agenda-aligned checklist.

Suggested windows (PST) — pick 2 that work for you and I’ll lock calendar:
- Tue 2026-11-30 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-12-01 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-12-02 11:00–12:30

Draft agenda (we can tweak):
1) 10m — goals, success criteria, current infra snapshot (EdgePay)
2) 20m — runtime architecture and routing/fallback options (Redwood)
3) 20m — security/compliance & KMS/VPC options (Redwood security)
4) 20m — model performance, quantization trade-offs, and cost levers
5) 10–20m — open Q&A and next steps (rollout plan, owners)

Attachments: I attached a short agenda PDF and a checklist of typical workshop asks so your team can prepare (logs, sample traffic profile, SOC2 contact).

If you want, loop in your security or procurement contacts now and we’ll make sure the right folks join.

Thanks — I’ll hold the suggested slots open until I hear which two you prefer.

—Sean
